searchText: Sorry I didn't realize that message is 6 month old. Is there a formal process right now? We are planning to run about 1000-5000 validators on testnet to gather data on different clients. Our plan is running these nodes for at least a year while it could go as long as testnet goes down. How should we proceed? For our general purposes holesky make more sense. We should gather more data about sepolia though. Sepolia runs less than a couple of thousand validators total, and is permissioned. You'd have to use holesky. That was my knowledge as well but after seing a offer I assumed it's possible
